title: pityopsis pinifolia
intro: Pityopsis pinifolia, commonly known as silver tops or false chamomile, is a flowering plant native to North America, specifically in the southeastern United States. The health benefits of Pityopsis pinifolia include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Pityopsis pinifolia include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
